transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my right knee, mainly. It's been aching on and off for a while, but it's got worse lately and it's really bothering me now.
Do you have any allergies, or have you ever had a bad reaction to a medicine?
Yes, I had a rash from some antibiotic once, years ago.
Are you taking any medicines at the moment — either ones you take regularly, or anything new or changed recently?
Yes, I take a few tablets every day — some for my sugar and some for my heart.
Have you ever had any operations?
I had a stent put in one of my heart arteries a few years back. Nothing else that I can think of.
Did you notice anything else going on when your knee started aching?
Not really — it sometimes gets a bit puffy by the evening, but nothing else stands out.
Is there anything you've noticed that seems to make the aching in your knee better, or worse?
Going down the stairs is the worst, and it aches if I'm on my feet for a while. Resting helps, and paracetamol takes the edge off.
When did you first start noticing the aching in your right knee?
It's been there on and off for a good while now — I couldn't put an exact figure on it.
What worries you most about your knee?
Mainly I'd like something stronger for the pain, and I do wonder whether I might end up needing a knee replacement.
How much would you say the aching in your knee affects your day-to-day activities?
It's getting in the way more and more — I can't walk the dog round the park like I used to. I go down the stairs one step at a time now, holding the rail.
When the aching in your right knee first started, did it come on suddenly, come on gradually, or are you not sure?
It came on gradually, I'd say — it's been about 3 years now, just niggling on and off.
How bad would you say the aching in your right knee is these days — mild, moderate, severe, or you're not sure?
On a bad day it's quite bad — I'd say about a 7 out of 10.
Which of these best describes your medicines at the moment: you take them regularly, you've started or changed some recently, you don't take any, or you're not sure?
They're ones I take regularly, every day. Metformin twice a day, and aspirin, atorvastatin and ramipril once a day.
Is there anything else you’d like to add about your medicines?
No, that's about it, I think. The statin I take at night, the rest in the morning.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
